scope: S numerical refinement at fixed prior corners and center; no inference or market evidence
case_design: Cartesian product of the two prior bounds in saved parameter order, followed by their midpoint
resolution_rule: abs(paired_mean_difference) + 4 * paired_standard_error <= 0.1 * quote_noise_std for each contract
marginal_sampling_rule: each grid price standard error <= 0.1 * quote_noise_std
one_factor_coupling: exact OU coarse innovations from weighted fine innovations, with coarse Brownian increments summed; exact shared factor endpoints
rough_coupling: sum disjoint fine independent normal blocks divided by sqrt(ratio), independently per channel; rebuild each grid hybrid field and its own variance normalization
stop_rule: Run each declared model/case once. Preserve all failures; no extra seeds, path counts, adaptive grids, changed tolerances, new training bank or neural training in this increment.
limitations: Finite-grid differences do not bound continuum price bias.
Four-SE screens are pointwise engineering diagnostics, not simultaneous confidence statements.
Five parameter cases do not establish uniform prior-wide accuracy.
Monte Carlo price-label error is separate from quote noise.
No inference validation or production-bank acceptance follows automatically.
